title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (12/20): Grandmother Jia's Dilemma
note_en: 与其说A，不如说B means "it's less A than B" or "not so much A as B": 与其说是天冷，不如说是心里发冷 "less from the cold weather than from the cold in her heart." The speaker sets up one explanation only to reject it in favor of a better one; English often flips the order ("not so much A as B"), but Chinese always gives the weaker option first, after 与其说.
